data.camera: medium shot, walking through the school hallway with textbooks
data.description: 阳东高中的午后走廊，黑川茜抱着课本走过光斑交错的窗边，蓝紫直发在阳光里泛着清冷的光泽，制服裙摆随着步伐轻摆——「戏外的我，也只是一个普通的高中生而已。」
data.promptProse: Akane carries the textbooks against her chest with both arms as she walks through the corridor. Afternoon window light lays bright bands across the floor ahead of her.
data.title: 黑川茜 · 阳东走廊
data.animaCaption: Both arms hold the textbooks against her chest as she walks along the corridor.
